docs.title: About us
docs.text: order manual items Menu About us Book a table About us Bistro Verde Teste opened in 2015 as a small family kitchen. Ten years later we are still a small kitchen, with a bigger table. Our dining room The dining room, ready for the evening. A neighbourhood bistro where the menu follows the market, the bread comes out of our oven every morning and the wine comes from people we know. Our kitchen We cook what the season brings and bake our bread every morning. Write here how you cook. Our suppliers Farmers and fishermen we know by name, most of them less than an hour away. Our wines From small producers we visit every year, many of them organic. A dish being plated Bread from our oven Our chef at the stove A glass of red wine text “The kind of place you keep for the people you love: a risotto we still talk about, and a table that never felt rushed.” name Maria Costa roles Dinner for two, October Book a table Call us or send a message. We always keep a few tables for walk-ins.
